title: Define the clue and difficulty model
context: Define how clues are generated and what makes a Logic Grid puzzle easy or hard.

spec.summary: Define the clue and difficulty model
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Difficulty is computed from a deterministic measure.
Generated puzzles land in the requested bucket or are regenerated.
Expose the measure from the solver.
The same puzzle gets the same difficulty.
A trivial puzzle and a hard puzzle land in different buckets.
